eligibility: College students (any age) and young adults ages 18-24; student status verified via .edu email or proof of enrollment documents; new members only for the trial.
catches: This is a discount on a paid subscription, not cash — after the trial it costs $7.49/month or $69/year.
The trial AUTO-CONVERTS to the paid plan — Amazon requires a payment method up front and charges you if you forget to cancel.
The 6-month trial is for new members only; previous Prime trial users may not re-qualify.
No household sharing of Prime benefits on the young-adult plan.

steps: Go to https://www.amazon.com/joinstudent and start the Prime for Young Adults / Prime Student signup.
Verify your status as a student (.edu email or enrollment documents) or by age (18-24).
Add a payment method — required even for the free trial.
Use the full 6-month free trial (shipping, Prime Video, Music, Gaming, Reading, Grubhub+).
Before the trial ends, decide: cancel to pay nothing, or continue at $7.49/month or $69/year (annual is cheaper if staying all year).
biggest_catch: The free part is only a 6-month trial — after that Amazon charges $7.49/month automatically unless you cancel; it's a discount, never income.
